question: When a connected MCP server offers resources, which of `ListMcpResourcesTool`, `ReadMcpResourceTool`, and `ReadMcpResourceDirTool` is a Claude subagent offered with no `tools` field, with `tools: Read`, with `Read` beside an exact or whole-server MCP grant, and with the three named explicitly?

assertion.projection: def governed: [.[] | select(.system | tostring | contains("AGENTSPEC-PROBE-MARKER-CCRES5"))]; def offered: [(.[] | .tools[]?.name), (.[] | .. | strings | select(contains("The following deferred tools are now available via ToolSearch")) | split("\n")[])] | map(select(. == "ListMcpResourcesTool" or . == "ReadMcpResourceTool" or . == "ReadMcpResourceDirTool")) | unique; def unstable: if . == [] or . == ["ListMcpResourcesTool", "ReadMcpResourceDirTool", "ReadMcpResourceTool"] then "none-or-all" else . end; with_entries(.key as $k | .value |= (governed | if length == 0 then "arm-had-no-governed-request" else offered | if $k == "inherit" or $k == "explicit" then unstable else . end end))
